title: Yoddha prep: pilot week (13-19 Oct)
versionNote: Pilot week, approved 13 Oct 2026. Revised after an independent review: Saturday rest and Sunday run, sled ladder capped at RPE 8 / 130 kg, 24 kg carry test moved to week 2, box-jump practice before Friday, easier Monday runs.
assumptions: Aryan's run, strength and station levels are unknown until this week's tests; his starting loads (80 kg sled push, 70 kg sled pull, 2 x 16 kg carry, 10 kg lunge) are assumptions.
Both partners run every 700 m together. The rulebook doesn't say so; this follows the HYROX convention until the organisers confirm.
Rower 'Resistance 7' is assumed to mean Concept2 damper 7.
Chinmay's longest run in the 30 days before the pilot was 5.76 km (4 Oct).

sessions.title: Lower-body strength + sled push
sessions.objective: Build leg strength for the sled and lunges, find the heaviest sled load you can push at a steady pace, and practise legal sled turns. Target effort RPE 6-7, nothing maximal.
warmup: Leg swings 10 per side, forward and sideways
10 bodyweight squats, 10 walking lunges, 10 glute bridges, 5 inchworms
2 light ramp-up sets of the squat

exercises.name: Back squat or goblet squat

load.guidance: About a 9-rep max; add 2.5-5 kg per set while RPE stays at 7 or below

exercises.notes: Write down the final weight.

aryan.notes: Use a goblet squat (dumbbell or kettlebell at the chest) if barbell form isn't solid.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
exercises.notes: Hinge at the hips, back flat, bar close to the legs, lower to mid-shin.

exercises.name: Sandbag walking lunge
exercises.notes: Race standard on every rep: back knee touches the floor, stand up fully, alternate legs. The rulebook lists +5 min for a knee that doesn't touch, so the partner watches for it.

load.guidance: Start at 10 kg or bodyweight (assumption); 20 kg once every rep is clean

exercises.name: Sled push ladder

load.guidance: Start ~100 kg, +10 kg per push; stop at RPE 8; cap 130 kg this week

exercises.notes: One lane (about 12-15 m) per push, taking turns, which gives each of you 60-90 s rest. Stop the ladder when a push feels like RPE 8 or the sled clearly slows; never push to a stall. The sled fully crosses the line before you turn, and you always face the direction of travel. Record the heaviest load pushed at a steady pace.

load.guidance: Start ~80 kg (assumption), +10 kg per push; stop at RPE 8

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.notes: 8 per side.

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.notes: 30 s per side.

cooldown: Stretch calves, hip flexors, hamstrings, quads and lats, 30 s each side
sessions.recovery: Legs will feel this on Wednesday, so keep Wednesday's run truly easy. Aryan: if you run in the morning, keep it easy (RPE 3-4, 40 min max).
stopCriteria: Chest pain or pressure, fainting or near-fainting, dizziness that doesn't settle, palpitations, breathlessness far out of proportion to the effort, or confusion: stop training and get medical advice before training again.
Heat illness signs (headache, nausea, chills in the heat, cramps, unusual weakness, sweating that stops): stop, get somewhere cool, sip water or ORS, and get help if not better in about 15 minutes.
Sharp or joint pain, pain that changes how you move, or pain that gets worse: stop that exercise.
sessions.lighterOption: Squat and RDL 2 sets each, lunges 2 x 20 m bodyweight, sled 4 pushes at your ladder starting load, no ladder.

sessions.title: Easy run-walk + row, wall-ball and box-jump technique
sessions.objective: Aerobic base at an easy pace, learning to run as a pair, and first technique practice on the rower, wall balls and box jumps.

exercises.name: Run-walk together
exercises.notes: Run 4 min / walk 1 min. You should be able to speak in full sentences. Chinmay decides when to walk; Aryan matches his pace. Stop at 3 km even if you feel good. Note total time and number of walk breaks.

exercises.name: Row technique
exercises.notes: Stroke rate 22-26. Legs, then body, then arms on the drive; arms, then body, then legs on the way back. Write down the drag factor at damper 7.

exercises.name: Wall-ball technique

load.guidance: 9 ft target, or the nearest target your gym has

exercises.notes: Hips below knees on every rep; catch the ball and drop straight into the next squat in one flow. The partner calls no-reps.

exercises.name: Box-jump practice
exercises.notes: 40-50 cm box. Two-foot take-off and landing, stand tall on top, step down. Prepares you for Friday's check.

cooldown: Stretch calves, hip flexors, hamstrings, quads and lats, 30 s each side
sessions.recovery: Easy day: it should leave you fresher, not tired.
stopCriteria: Chest pain or pressure, fainting or near-fainting, dizziness that doesn't settle, palpitations, breathlessness far out of proportion to the effort, or confusion: stop training and get medical advice before training again.
Heat illness signs (headache, nausea, chills in the heat, cramps, unusual weakness, sweating that stops): stop, get somewhere cool, sip water or ORS, and get help if not better in about 15 minutes.
Sharp or joint pain, pain that changes how you move, or pain that gets worse: stop that exercise.
sessions.lighterOption: 2 km run-walk (3 min run / 1 min walk); skip the wall balls and box jumps.

sessions.title: Upper body + sled pull + carries
sessions.objective: Pulling strength and grip for the sled pull and, later, the 2 x 24 kg carry. Replaces the two separate pull days with one upper-body day. RPE 6-7.

exercises.name: Strict pull-ups
exercises.notes: Stop each set well short of your max.

aryan.notes: 4 sets of (his max minus 2), or lat pulldown 4 x 8 at RPE 7 if he can't do 5 strict (assumption until tested).

exercises.name: One-arm dumbbell row
exercises.notes: 10 per side.

exercises.name: Sled pull

load.guidance: Work from 80 kg up to 100 kg only if the sled keeps moving smoothly

exercises.notes: 3 lanes each, taking turns. Hand over hand, stay standing, feet inside the athlete box, rope inside your lane.

load.guidance: Start at 70 kg (assumption until we have his numbers)

exercises.name: Kettlebell farmer's carry
exercises.notes: Arms straight at your sides. Stop each set before your grip fails. The 2 x 24 kg race-weight test moves to week 2 so your grip is fresh for Friday's row.

load.guidance: 2 x 16 kg, up to 2 x 20 kg if controlled (assumption)

cooldown: Stretch calves, hip flexors, hamstrings, quads and lats, 30 s each side
sessions.recovery: Friday is the test day, so keep tonight's effort controlled. Aryan: an easy morning run is fine (40 min max, RPE 3-4).
stopCriteria: Chest pain or pressure, fainting or near-fainting, dizziness that doesn't settle, palpitations, breathlessness far out of proportion to the effort, or confusion: stop training and get medical advice before training again.
Heat illness signs (headache, nausea, chills in the heat, cramps, unusual weakness, sweating that stops): stop, get somewhere cool, sip water or ORS, and get help if not better in about 15 minutes.
Sharp or joint pain, pain that changes how you move, or pain that gets worse: stop that exercise.
sessions.lighterOption: Pull-ups 3 x 4, skip the dumbbell row, sled pull 2 lanes at 80 kg, carries 3 x 30 m at 2 x 16 kg.

sessions.title: Baseline tests (controlled, not maximal)
sessions.objective: Real numbers for both athletes, so next week's paces, loads and station split are based on data. RPE 7-8 maximum. Tuesday's steady sled load counts as this week's sled test.
warmup: 2 x 80 m strides building to moderate

exercises.name: 700 m run test
exercises.notes: Controlled hard. Each athlete runs it separately, so Aryan's number is his own. Walk 5 min afterwards. Chinmay: try it without a walk break; if you need one, take it and write it down.

exercises.name: 1,000 m row test
exercises.notes: Strong and even, not all-out. One rows while the other rests and records. Record total time, average /500 m split and drag factor.

exercises.name: Wall balls: max unbroken valid reps
exercises.notes: Cap 30 reps. Stop at the first no-rep or form break. Rest 3 min afterwards.

exercises.name: Box-jump check at 60 cm
exercises.notes: A technique check, not timed. Two-foot take-off and landing, full hip and knee extension on top, step down. If 60 cm feels unsafe, use 50 cm and note it.

cooldown: Stretch calves, hip flexors, hamstrings, quads and lats, 30 s each side
sessions.recovery: Aryan: no morning run today. Weigh before and after the session (towel off, same clothes) to estimate sweat loss. At home, soak rice and urad dal for Saturday's idli batter.
stopCriteria: Chest pain or pressure, fainting or near-fainting, dizziness that doesn't settle, palpitations, breathlessness far out of proportion to the effort, or confusion: stop training and get medical advice before training again.
Heat illness signs (headache, nausea, chills in the heat, cramps, unusual weakness, sweating that stops): stop, get somewhere cool, sip water or ORS, and get help if not better in about 15 minutes.
Sharp or joint pain, pain that changes how you move, or pain that gets worse: stop that exercise.
Stop any test if form breaks down.
sessions.lighterOption: Do only the 700 m run and the wall balls, both at RPE 7.

sessions.title: Full rest
sessions.objective: Recover from Friday's tests and bank sleep before Sunday's morning run.
sessions.recovery: Chinmay: rest; an optional 20-30 min easy walk is fine. Aryan: rest, or an easy run (40 min max, RPE 3) only if he feels fresh. Early dinner (8:30 pm) and aim to be asleep by about 1 am, so you get 6.5-7 h before Sunday's run. Soak moong dal tonight for Sunday's chilla. Lay out kit.

sessions.title: Easy 5 km run-walk (morning)
sessions.objective: Aerobic base, and building toward race-length running without a risky jump in distance. No evening session.

exercises.name: Run-walk 5 km
exercises.notes: Start around 8 am (or your usual time). Run 5 min / walk 1 min. Cap at 5.5 km: Chinmay's longest run in the last 30 days was 5.76 km (4 Oct). Mumbai mornings are warm and humid, so start easy. Aryan runs at Chinmay's pace; this replaces his own Sunday run.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.notes: 8 per side.

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.notes: 30 s per side.

cooldown: Stretch calves, hip flexors, hamstrings and quads, 30 s each side
sessions.recovery: Early dinner (8:30 pm) and an earlier bedtime tonight.
stopCriteria: Chest pain or pressure, fainting or near-fainting, dizziness that doesn't settle, palpitations, breathlessness far out of proportion to the effort, or confusion: stop training and get medical advice before training again.
Heat illness signs (headache, nausea, chills in the heat, cramps, unusual weakness, sweating that stops): stop, get somewhere cool, sip water or ORS, and get help if not better in about 15 minutes.
Sharp or joint pain, pain that changes how you move, or pain that gets worse: stop that exercise.

sessions.title: Run-to-station practice + doubles switching
sessions.objective: First practice of moving from a run straight into a station, legal doubles switching, and pacing as a pair. The runs are deliberately easy. This is not a race simulation. RPE 5-6 overall.
warmup: Leg swings 10 per side, forward and sideways
10 bodyweight squats, 10 walking lunges, 10 glute bridges, 5 inchworms

blocks.name: Run to station x 3 (walk 2-3 min between rounds)

exercises.name: Run 700 m
exercises.notes: Easy run-walk together. Chinmay takes walk breaks as needed; Aryan stays with him. Record the split.

exercises.name: Sled push
exercises.notes: One lane each: 2 lanes for the pair, switching pusher every lane.

exercises.name: Run 700 m
exercises.notes: Easy run-walk together. Record the split.

exercises.name: Sandbag lunges
exercises.notes: 2 x 10 m each. Hand the sandbag over at a cone marked as the swap zone, the only legal place to switch in the race.

exercises.name: Run 700 m
exercises.notes: Easy run-walk together. Record the split.

exercises.name: Wall balls
exercises.notes: 30 reps for the pair, switching every 10: Chinmay takes turns 1 and 3, Aryan turn 2. Swap roles next time.

cooldown: Stretch calves, hip flexors, hamstrings, quads and lats, 30 s each side
sessions.recovery: Aryan: no morning run today. Week 2 is planned from what this week shows.
stopCriteria: Chest pain or pressure, fainting or near-fainting, dizziness that doesn't settle, palpitations, breathlessness far out of proportion to the effort, or confusion: stop training and get medical advice before training again.
Heat illness signs (headache, nausea, chills in the heat, cramps, unusual weakness, sweating that stops): stop, get somewhere cool, sip water or ORS, and get help if not better in about 15 minutes.
Sharp or joint pain, pain that changes how you move, or pain that gets worse: stop that exercise.
sessions.lighterOption: 2 rounds only, sled about 30% under Tuesday's steady load.
